title: Commander Cleave - Location, Weakness & How to Beat (Phantom Blade Zero)
description: Commander Cleave in Phantom Blade Zero - what has been confirmed about the encounter, its elemental weakness, rewards and how to approach it.

facts.label: First shown
facts.value: Playable 2024 demo, covered by IGN hands-on

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Commander Cleave is the second boss available in Phantom Blade Zero's playable demo and the one that functions as the demo's real skill check. He is a larger opponent built around a cleaver sword that breaks through defensive play, and the hands-on coverage describes timing as the answer to him rather than aggression or blocking.

sections.title: Where to Find the Commander Cleave
sections.content:
Location: Tie Sha (demo level).

First shown: Playable 2024 demo, covered by IGN hands-on.

Not confirmed pre-launch. S-GAME has not published elemental affinities for this encounter, and no demo footage shows one being exploited. Nothing here is estimated from the boss's appearance - that is exactly how wrong weakness tables get written before release.

sections.title: Rewards
sections.content: Not confirmed pre-launch. Bosses in Phantom Blade Zero are described by S-GAME as rewarding unique weapons on defeat, but no drop table has been published for this encounter, so none is listed here.

sections.title: How to Beat the Commander Cleave
sections.content:
What has actually been shown

  • Fought after the Tie Sha section of the demo
  • Wields a cleaver sword whose attacks tear through Soul's guard
  • Substantial health pool and its own defensive options
  • Described in coverage as the first genuine skill test the demo presents

Everything above comes from footage S-GAME released. Anything not listed has not been shown, however confident a write-up elsewhere looks.

How to approach it

  • The cleaver attacks are the ones to read rather than block, which matters because blocking also spends the Sha-chi resource you need for your own heavy attacks
  • Weapon swapping is the practical tool here: switching restores stamina immediately, so a combo can be continued instead of abandoned when the health bar does not move

sections.title: Pre-launch Status
sections.content: This page tracks the Commander Cleave in Phantom Blade Zero, which releases on October 29, 2026. It is written from official demo and trailer material only. After release it gets updated with verified fight data; see the boss guide for the full roster and the video guide index for walkthroughs.
